description: Fixed signer-disjoint split of WL-BISINDO (Indonesian Sign Language, Banten variant) for cross-lingual transfer evaluation (P1, 6th target language). 32 signs x 5 signers x ~10 samples = 1600 clips. Signers 1-4 cover all 32 classes; partial signer 0 (12 classes) is EXCLUDED. train=signers 1-2, val=3, test=4 (signer-disjoint).
